# Purchased and private asset policy

## Preserve purchased and private asset boundaries

Identify whether changed assets are purchased, private, generated, redistributable, or public fallbacks before judging the diff. Preserve license notices and source attribution. Flag newly committed private source files, unauthorized redistribution, accidental replacement of purchased originals, and public builds that depend on unavailable private paths. Verify that fallback assets are actually reachable and that generated outputs do not erase provenance. Do not recommend deleting or replacing licensed assets merely to simplify CI.
